summary: The new module entitlement and delegated hotel-administration boundaries pass their scoped Rules/backend review and ordinary-user emulator controls. Existing operational schema debt remains. This assessment concerns repository code, not deployed Rules, IAM or production readiness.

findings.issue: Inherited Firestore locations and outlet CRUD rules check licensed action authority but lack a per-document field/type/size schema. An authorized manager can corrupt that hotel's configuration or consume storage within Firestore's document limits. The separate approver child collection remains backend-only; this does not grant platform or another hotel's authority.
findings.recommendation: In a focused configuration-hardening task, define the real location/template/outlet payload contracts and enforce matching bounded create/update schemas with valid workflow and malformed-payload regressions. Do not replace the existing domain shapes blindly.

checks.result: Subscription, membership, guard and audit writes are denied to browser clients, including platform clients on protected paths. Backend writes validate current authority, expected revisions and explicit entitlements; resends preserve grants.

Ordinary delegation requires canonical hotelAdmin membership, verified enabled current Auth identity and rollout/subscription checks. Payload roles cannot grant platform claims or user-administration permission keys.

Licensed positive create/read/update/stock/quote/file paths pass alongside denied paths. Full populated quote create/stale/outcome tests pass within the expression budget. Concurrent seats and last-admin mutations have one safe winner.

Explicit module lists, role counts, advanced permissions, names, email, pages and optional seats are bounded. Image/import uploads retain positive-size, maximum-size and declared-type enforcement. Inherited configuration schema issue is listed above.

Unknown/missing/malformed module policy denies access across frontend, backend and Rules. Boolean administrator selection, seat/revision integers and known unique role/module IDs are validated. Generated Rules match the shared catalog.

Hotel ID, caller membership and administrator authority are checked before listing/mutating members. Legacy identity hydration uses only paged selected-hotel member IDs. Local edits and removals preserve independent hotel memberships and shared account state.

evidence.security: 106 passing tests across 14 Auth/Firestore/Storage emulator suites
evidence.migration: Real emulator dry-run, apply, idempotence, stale lease and invalid-manifest preflight tests
evidence.restore: Two-hotel Firestore/Auth/private Storage export/import smoke including module entitlements, admin grants and guard/audit

remaining_checks: Actual deployed matching Rules/Functions/frontend and Storage-to-Firestore IAM
Reviewed hotel module/admin migrations and backup/restore in an isolated real project
Ordinary-user browser acceptance and approved invitation/provider delivery
Human PR review and production release approval
